cuts.label: ludwig@vod2877651495/ludwig-cancun-fight-2026w38
cuts.title: Ludwig Calls It 'Our Season' Then Watches The Fight
cuts.hook: Ludwig's Shopify Rebellion: one fight decides
cuts.retelling: Ludwig, nervous that a League of Legends fight will decide his team Shopify Rebellion's season, goes wild when they win it and then celebrates a 3-0 reverse sweep.

cuts.label: claytonerp@momentgoodcourteousayeayemrdestructoid-8oea0efz-qqbokp3/claytonerp-anoth-casino-2026w41
cuts.title: Clayton Hosts A Casino Fight Night And It Goes Wrong
cuts.hook: Clayton hosts fights, then it turns deadly
cuts.retelling: A GTA roleplay casino host runs bump fights, hands a fighter a knife mid-fight, gets stabbed, and is carried down to a basement full of blood and bodies that shocks him.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2824281072/kaicenat-announc-award-2026w30
cuts.title: Mr. Keem wins twice at Streamer University
cuts.hook: Keem wins twice at Kai's ceremony
cuts.retelling: At Kai Cenat's Streamer University ceremony, Mr. Keem is picked by Ludwig for his Streamer Games team and then named valedictorian with a Dell brand deal, so he wins twice in one night.

cuts.label: andrsurov@momentpuzzledroundbadgerwoofer-nkhrre_96wn-sqpd/andrsurov-abandon-build-2026w41
cuts.title: 'We are not scared' — how a shoot in an abandoned building went
cuts.retelling: A group in an abandoned building loudly insists they're not scared, then we rewind to them filming a 'camera, motor, go' take, and something at a door spooks them into running.

cuts.label: emiru@vod2880439404/emiru-about-bother-2026w39
cuts.title: Emiru's shirt asks if this guy is bothering you
cuts.hook: Emiru's shirt asks if this guy is
cuts.retelling: Emiru shows off a shirt asking 'Is this guy bothering you?', brings out her orange cat as the 'guy', then he takes her chair and she ends up sharing it with him.

cuts.label: yonnajay@momentcautiouscrepusculardadshazbotstix-cnpaszoaxa7msxvb/yonnajay-fair-gett-2026w41
cuts.title: Yonna blames the cameraman at the Texas State Fair
cuts.hook: Yonna blames her cameraman for yesterday
cuts.retelling: Yonna says she is stressed and blames her cameraman for yesterday, then scolds him for leaving her phone in the Uber.

cuts.label: scout:burn+pengwin/burn-pengwin-baitline-catch-2026w42
cuts.title: Pengwin gets surrounded in a hot tub by Burn's bait crew
cuts.hook: Pengwin in a hot tub: "Eh? Nani?"
cuts.retelling: A streamer in a hot tub is approached by a crew he can't hear, and another streamer's side shows they set the bait, until the crew says they're from Baitline LSBN and are there to catch a weeb.
